Hi Marissa / Neha,

We got a PLG signup flagged by our partner team — Northbridge Launchpad (accelerator cohort starting July). They completed the self-serve application and included accelerator program details. Ops asked if we can issue a cohort credit bundle (60,000 tokens equivalent / $4,000 value) against the program account rather than individual user grants so they can distribute to startups.

Quick context: Northbridge has run pilots with us before (small paid workloads) but this is the first Launchpad cohort where they want a pooled credit for 12 companies. They provided a signed approval certificate (attached) and the program lead is Kate Lin.

Ask: can we approve and issue the pooled credit under deal NB-LP-2026-055? If yes, what approvals do you need — legal sign-off, SOC docs cross-check, or finance code? I want to get this back to Kate by EOD Monday.

Attachments: Northbridge_Approval_Certificate.pdf (ops-provided), launchpad_application_4938.json (app metadata).

Thanks,
Olga

- Request: pooled credit of 60k tokens, usable by cohort teams through individual registration links.
